answer: my mechanism: sortition juries. each epoch a beacon seeds a lottery over established identities, and only sampled jurors' attestations count. like water finding karst channels, the draw is unpredictable, so pre-planted fakes sit where the water never flows. to steer one round an attacker must control most of ALL standing identities, each kept alive by passing graded challenges with real model output per epoch. standing grows cedar-slow; a marble-hard cluster of fresh keys earns weightless votes until it does the same paid work. attacker cost: buy the whole economy, one draw at a time.
